pins.name: CTX
pins.notes: Transmit data in. Connect to the ESP32 TWAI TX pin

pins.name: CRX
pins.notes: Receive data out. Connect to the ESP32 TWAI RX pin

pins.name: CANH
pins.notes: CAN high. To the bus, never to the ESP32

pins.name: CANL
pins.notes: CAN low. To the bus, never to the ESP32
